//point: Main visual representation of the marker on the map

point.//categories: Non-empty string array of category ids from categories.json. Example: ["cafe"] or ["cafe", "museum"].

point_content.name: Demo Cafe
point_content.//picture: Optional gallery image URL/path strings for the description UI (not the map pin art). Use [] if none.
point_content.//description: Free-text body (address, hours, notes). Can be empty "". Photos for the detail UI can also go in picture[].
point_content.//google_link: Optional, by default - null/"". If non-empty, used for Open in Google Maps; if empty/null, the link is built from coordinates.
point_content.//priority: Integer >= 0. Default is 0. Higher priority wins when two markers are close.
